description: This PHP source file defines the SkillService class, which provides service-layer functionalities for managing skills within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the data access object (SkillDao) to perform CRUD operations and search functions related to skills.

classes.name: SkillService
classes.description: Service class that manages skills, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and searching of skills, encapsulating business logic and data access interactions.

methods.name: getSkillDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of SkillDao.

methods.name: setSkillDao
methods.description: Sets the SkillDao instance; useful for dependency injection or mocking in tests.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Saves a Skill entity via the DAO and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes multiple skills given their IDs and returns the count of deleted records.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Searches for skills based on provided filter parameters, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of skills matching the search filters, throws ServiceException on failure.
